title: Finite double dual preserves a finite locally free restriction
statement:
theorem affine_double_dual_restriction
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M]
    (P : W.toScheme.Modules) [P.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (e : Modules.restrict (tilde M) W.ι ≅ P) :
    Nonempty (Modules.restrict
      (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (Module.Dual A (Module.Dual A M)))) W.ι ≅ P)

proof.text: Apply new-affine-dual-restriction-comparison to M and its finite first dual. Noetherianity supplies finiteness of the first dual. This gives restriction of tilde(M**) isomorphic to the sheaf dual of the restriction of tilde(M*).

The contravariant sheaf Hom functor takes the first comparison to an isomorphism from the sheaf double dual of N = restriction of tilde M to the sheaf dual of restriction of tilde(M*). Compose its inverse with the second comparison. Transport finite local freeness from P along e.symm. The already proved SheafOfModules.isIso_bidual N then gives N isomorphic to its sheaf double dual; compose its inverse and e to obtain the required isomorphism. These are the actual Lean compositions, including the empty open and rank zero.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0583 and 0EY6 proof of (1); single-dual comparison twice, then source-library SheafOfModules.isIso_bidual
